Operator direction, 2026-11-12: follow the repo's established conventions. That supersedes both earlier comments on this ticket. The baseline is not edited by hand.

Per docs/architecture.md §"Mechanism-delta ratchet" and sunset_markers.py, a mechanism added after the baseline froze is admitted only by a marker that names an open ticket. For a permanent setting, that ticket is the standing admission ticket cankered-cloistered-bittern (7447-47d8-051d-42ab). It is not part of the epic, so the epic can still close. The description now says to repoint the marker at that ticket.
